en.headline: Work week starts mainly fine, turning windier and cloudier midweek
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory forecasts mainly fine conditions on Monday under a northeast monsoon, with increasing cloud and occasional light rain later in the week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to Guangdong on Monday, with temperatures ranging from 26 to 31 degrees Celsius and relative humidity between 60 and 85 per cent. Winds will be east to northeast force 3 to 4.

From Tuesday onwards, a replenishment of the monsoon is expected to make conditions windier and gradually cloudier. Tuesday will be mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches at first and sunny periods during the day, temperatures 26 to 30 degrees. Wednesday and Thursday will see east force 4 to 5 winds, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground, with mainly cloudy skies and sunny intervals.

Friday is forecast to be mainly fine with east force 3 to 4 winds and temperatures 25 to 30 degrees. The Yellow Fire Danger Warning remains in force as dry conditions persist. No tropical cyclone signals are in force, with Tropical Storm Champi moving away towards Japan.

The Observatory advised that fire risk remains high under the current dry monsoon. Members of the public should take precautions against strong winds later in the week, particularly offshore and on high ground.

zh.headline: 下周初大致天晴 周中風勢轉大雲量增多
zh.dek: 天文台預測周一在東北季候風下大致天晴，周中起風勢增強，雲量逐漸增多，間中有微雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，乾燥的東北季候風將於周一為廣東帶來大致良好天氣，氣溫介乎26至31度，相對濕度60%至85%，吹東至東北風3至4級。
周二起季候風補充，風勢會轉大，天色逐漸轉多雲。周二大致多雲，初時有一兩陣微雨，日間部分時間有陽光，氣溫26至30度。周三及周四吹東風4至5級，離岸及高地間中6級，大致多雲，日間有短暫陽光。
周五預計大致天晴，吹東風3至4級，氣溫25至30度。黃色火災危險警告仍然生效，乾燥天氣持續。現時並無熱帶氣旋警告信號生效，熱帶風暴薔琵正移向日本。
天文台提醒，現時乾燥季候風下火險頗高。市民應留意周中風勢增強，特別是離岸及高地地區，採取適當防風措施。
